title: feat(nszparzinc): z-axis opposite-lock z-probe same-tick union own-lock: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: z-axis opposite-lock seed read on z-probes, so probe A=(0,0,1) IS a seed (t(A)=0, L(A)=-e_1). One of only three cells in the band where the union with L(q) is NOT a no-op, and the only kind where reverse_hold_channel=uses_L_A: the HOLD is destroyed if the probe's own lock is dropped. This isolates the exact condition under which the '∪ own lock' generation is more than a rename of the previous one -- the probe must be a seed.
